message: BUNDLE_COOLDOWN: "0" in .bundle/config turns off the cooldown of Bundler for every source, in place of the cooldown: of the Gemfile; Bundler reads .bundle/config before the environment
fix: Remove BUNDLE_COOLDOWN from .bundle/config (bundle config unset --local cooldown), so that the cooldown: of the Gemfile applies, or set it to at least 3

message: BUNDLE_COOLDOWN=1 in the env of job test in .github/workflows/ci.yml reaches every Bundler command there and sets the cooldown of Bundler to 1 day for every source in place of the cooldown: of the Gemfile, shorter than the 3d of depcurfew.json
fix: Remove BUNDLE_COOLDOWN from that env in .github/workflows/ci.yml; for a gem that cannot wait, run bundle update GEM --cooldown 0 by hand after reviewing it

message: job update in .github/workflows/ci.yml (line 20) runs a bundle command with --cooldown 0, which turns off the cooldown of Bundler for that command, in place of the cooldown: of the Gemfile
fix: Remove --cooldown 0 from that command in .github/workflows/ci.yml; for a gem that cannot wait, run bundle update GEM --cooldown 0 by hand after reviewing it

message: job update in .github/workflows/ci.yml (line 21) runs a bundle command with BUNDLE_COOLDOWN=2, which sets the cooldown of Bundler to 2 days for that command in place of the cooldown: of the Gemfile, shorter than the 3d of depcurfew.json
fix: Remove BUNDLE_COOLDOWN from that command or the place that sets it in .github/workflows/ci.yml; for a gem that cannot wait, run bundle update GEM --cooldown 0 by hand after reviewing it

message: BUNDLE_COOLDOWN=${{ matrix.cooldown }} in the env of step 4 of job update in .github/workflows/ci.yml reaches every Bundler command there and may turn off the cooldown of Bundler or shorten it, for every source
fix: Remove BUNDLE_COOLDOWN from that env in .github/workflows/ci.yml, or make sure it is never shorter than 3 days

message: the stage at line 1 in Dockerfile (line 5) runs a bundle command with BUNDLE_COOLDOWN=0, which turns off the cooldown of Bundler for that command, in place of the cooldown: of the Gemfile
fix: Remove BUNDLE_COOLDOWN from that command or the place that sets it in Dockerfile; for a gem that cannot wait, run bundle update GEM --cooldown 0 by hand after reviewing it
